image_page_title: Free Image Tools: Compress, Resize, Convert & Crop
image_page_description: Free browser-based image tools to compress, resize, convert and crop images, create QR codes and favicons, or turn images into PDF. Files stay on your device.
image_intro: Prepare images in a few clicks. Compress files, resize them, convert JPG, PNG and WebP, or crop with a visual selection. Processing happens on your device.
image_drop_hint: or choose one from your device
image_supported: JPG, PNG or WebP · Up to 25 MB
image_crop_hint: Drag on the image to select the area to keep.
image_jpeg_note: Transparent areas are filled with white in JPG.
image_local_note: Your files are processed in this browser and are not uploaded to Nobaj.
image_guide_compress_title: Compress without losing more quality than needed
image_guide_compress_text: WebP and JPG can reduce file size with adjustable quality. PNG keeps transparency and is best when you need lossless output.
